about: The questions a live quiz room deals from. Ten per game, the same ten on every phone in the room. Written for adults who have read the text: the answer is in Scripture, not in the Sunday-school version of it.

questions.q: Who did Jesus say was the neighbour in the parable of the good Samaritan?
questions.why: “The one who had mercy on him.” Jesus turns the lawyer’s question round: not who counts as my neighbour, but whether I am one.

questions.q: In the parable of the lost son, what does the older brother refuse to do?
questions.why: He stays outside, and the story ends with the father pleading with him. It never says whether he went in.

questions.q: What did Jesus write in the ground when the woman caught in adultery was brought to him?
questions.why: John records that he wrote, twice, and never what. Every confident answer to this question is a guess.

questions.q: Who asked Jesus, “What is truth?”
questions.why: Pilate asks it and walks out before an answer — with the Truth standing in front of him.

questions.q: Which book ends with the words “Should I not be concerned about that great city?”
questions.why: Jonah ends on God’s question, not Jonah’s answer. The reader is left to answer it.

questions.q: Who said, “Where you go I will go, and where you stay I will stay”?
questions.why: A daughter-in-law to a widow with nothing left to offer her. It is a vow of loyalty, not romance.

questions.q: What did Solomon ask God for at Gibeon?
questions.why: He asked for wisdom to judge the people well — and was given riches and honour as well.

questions.q: Who hid the Israelite spies on her roof in Jericho?
questions.why: Rahab hid them under stalks of flax. She is named in Jesus’ genealogy and in Hebrews 11.

questions.q: What was Paul’s trade?
questions.why: He worked with Priscilla and Aquila in Corinth so as not to be a burden on the churches.

questions.q: Which prophet was told to marry a woman who would be unfaithful to him?
questions.why: Hosea’s marriage to Gomer is the sermon: God’s faithfulness to an unfaithful people.

questions.q: “The Lord is my shepherd” opens which psalm?
questions.why: A psalm of David, who had been a shepherd before he was a king.

questions.q: Who was the first Christian martyr recorded in Acts?
questions.why: Stephen, one of the seven chosen to serve at tables. Saul watched the coats.

questions.q: What did Jesus say to Peter three times by the lake after the resurrection?
questions.why: Three questions for three denials, and each time a charge: feed, take care of, feed.

questions.q: According to Micah, what does the Lord require?
options: To act justly, love mercy and walk humbly
Burnt offerings and rivers of oil
questions.why: Micah answers the question of what religion God actually wants — and it is not more of it.

questions.q: Who wrestled with God and was renamed Israel?
questions.why: At the Jabbok, all night. He came away blessed and limping.

questions.q: Which disciple is described as “the one Jesus loved”?
questions.why: The Fourth Gospel never names him. The church has long understood it to be John.

questions.q: What were the Bereans commended for?
questions.why: They received the message eagerly and checked it against Scripture — both at once.

questions.q: Who said, “If I perish, I perish”?
questions.why: Before going to the king unsummoned, after three days of fasting.

questions.q: In Romans 8, what can separate us from the love of God?
questions.why: Paul lists death, life, angels, powers, height and depth — and then “anything else in all creation”.

questions.q: Which fruit of the Spirit is listed first in Galatians 5?
questions.why: Love, joy, peace, forbearance, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness and self-control.

questions.q: Who told Naaman to wash seven times in the Jordan?
questions.why: Through a messenger — Elisha did not even come out, which offended Naaman nearly as much as the river.

questions.q: What did the widow put into the temple treasury?
questions.why: Everything she had to live on. Jesus says she gave more than all the others.

questions.q: Which book says, “There is a time for everything”?
questions.why: “A time to be born and a time to die… a time to mourn and a time to dance.”

questions.q: Who was Timothy’s grandmother, named by Paul for her sincere faith?
questions.why: Lois, and then his mother Eunice. Faith passed down, and named.

questions.q: What does James say faith is without works?
questions.why: “As the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without deeds is dead.”

questions.q: Who built the ark of the covenant?
questions.why: Bezalel, filled with the Spirit of God with wisdom and skill in all kinds of crafts.

questions.q: Where was Paul when he wrote “I have learned to be content whatever the circumstances”?
questions.why: Philippians is a prison letter. Contentment, learned in chains.

questions.q: Which Old Testament figure was taken up to heaven in a whirlwind?
questions.why: Elijah, with Elisha watching. Enoch “was no more, because God took him” — no whirlwind mentioned.

questions.q: What did Joseph tell his brothers about what they had done to him?
options: “You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good”
“You are forgiven because you are family”
questions.why: He does not pretend it was not evil. He says God was at work in it anyway.

questions.q: Who was the tax collector who climbed a sycamore-fig tree?
questions.why: He gave half his goods to the poor and paid back fourfold — after Jesus came to his house, not before.

questions.q: What did the Philippian jailer ask Paul and Silas?
options: “What must I do to be saved?”
questions.why: After an earthquake at midnight and prisoners who stayed. He and his household were baptised that night.

questions.q: According to 1 John, what does perfect love drive out?
questions.why: “There is no fear in love. But perfect love drives out fear.”

questions.q: Who said, “Speak, for your servant is listening”?
questions.why: A boy in the temple at night, told by Eli what to say the third time he was called.

questions.q: What did Jesus say is the greatest commandment?
options: Love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul and mind
questions.why: And the second is like it: love your neighbour as yourself. “All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two.”

questions.q: Which letter says, “I can do all this through him who gives me strength”?
questions.why: Said about being content with plenty or with little — not about winning.

questions.q: In Hebrews 11, faith is described as confidence in what?
questions.why: “Confidence in what we hope for and assurance about what we do not see.”
